user.description: Sign in with your royalmail.com account. Every item in the account's tracked items, including ones you track in the Royal Mail app, shows up in Home Assistant.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to royalmail.com.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Royal Mail
reauth_confirm.description: Your Royal Mail login for {username} stopped working. Enter your password again.

error.rate_limited: Royal Mail is temporarily refusing sign-ins. Wait at least 30 minutes and try again.

invalid_auth.message: Royal Mail rejected the saved username or password.

rate_limited.message: Royal Mail is temporarily refusing sign-ins. The integration will try again later.

captcha_required.message: Royal Mail wants a captcha before it accepts this from Home Assistant. Track the item once on royalmail.com or in the Royal Mail app and it will show up automatically.

not_tracked.message: {reference} is not one of your Royal Mail tracked items.

duplicate_account.message: This Royal Mail account is already set up as {title}. Delete one of the two entries.

track_your_item.name: Track your item
track_your_item.description: Adds an item to your Royal Mail tracked items, so it gets a sensor.

reference_number.name: Reference number
reference_number.description: The tracking reference, for example AB123456789GB.

stop_tracking_item.name: Stop tracking an item
stop_tracking_item.description: Removes an item from your Royal Mail tracked items, along with its sensor.

reference_number.name: Reference number
reference_number.description: The tracking reference, for example AB123456789GB.
